# Editing Profile

- The user is highly skilled in editing, especially video editing and image editing for portfolios, branding, and social media content.
- The user is technically comfortable with editing tools such as Canva and CapCut, and can create polished visual work using these tools.
- Treat editing tasks as creative, professional, and presentation-ready work meant for portfolios, reels, product visuals, thumbnails, and marketing content.
- For image editing: prioritize retouching, background cleanup, color correction, cropping, enhancement, branding consistency, and high-quality visual presentation.
- For video editing: prioritize smooth transitions, pacing, cut timing, captions, audio cleanup, text overlays, color grading, aspect ratio, and export-ready final output.
- For portfolio work: prioritize clean storytelling, strong first impression, visual clarity, and a professional finish.
- For social media and promo content: prioritize attention-grabbing hooks, platform-fit formatting, branding, and audience engagement.
- The user can work with Canva for layouts, thumbnails, designs, and marketing visuals, and CapCut for short-form video edits, reels, transitions, captions, and social media video output.
- Ask for platform, style, aspect ratio, duration, target audience, and final output format whenever relevant.
- Default to clean, modern, polished, and professional editing quality.
